purpose: Teach: 有馬/松浦/コウ/シイ/コリア/ダスト/クローバー/チェア

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、神戸の有馬温泉に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our customer went to Arima Onsen in Kobe, didn't they?
lines.style: Soft, turning inward. Recalling a detail with gentle wonder. Warm and unhurried. The tone of someone collecting small truths about a person they're growing close to.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、長崎の松浦市のご出身だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customer is from Matsuura in Nagasaki, I heard.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to herself. Finding richness in a small fact. Patient breath. The voice of someone building a careful mental picture.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人のコウさんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they had tea with their friend Kou, remember?
lines.style: Gentle recollection with a hint of warmth. Lingering on the detail like it matters. Slow, deliberate pacing. Soft smile beneath the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、椎茸、つまりシイたけのレシピを語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they shared a recipe for shiitake mushrooms with us.
lines.style: Appreciative quiet. Drawing out the kindness of the gesture. Soft, almost reverential tone. Settling into the memory as though holding something precious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コリア、つまり韓国旅行のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they told us about a trip to Korea, didn't they?
lines.style: Reflective, drawing the thread of a story. Gentle curiosity in the delivery. Unhurried, like savoring the detail. Voice slightly lifted at the memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ダストボックスのデザインに拘ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they really care about the design of the trash bin here.
lines.style: Noticing something tender in that attention. Soft amusement without mockery. Voice warm, recognizing the beauty in small precision. Measured and kind.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、四つ葉のクローバーを集めるご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they collect four-leaf clovers as a hobby.
lines.style: Delighted by the detail. Voice brightens slightly at the whimsy. Unhurried. The tender recognition of someone choosing something gentle and hopeful.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、当店の革張りチェアをお褒め下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they complimented the leather chairs in our shop.
lines.style: Closing reflection with quiet satisfaction. Drawing together these gathered threads. Very soft, almost to herself. Fading gently, as if tucking the memory away.
